question_text: What do you do when you see this traffic sign on an autobahn?

options.text: Increase your alertness and, as a matter of precaution, increase your distance to the vehicle in front
In case of a traffic jam, brake and switch on hazard warning lights
In case of a traffic jam, move over onto the hard shoulder and proceed

correct_answers.text: Increase your alertness and, as a matter of precaution, increase your distance to the vehicle in front
In case of a traffic jam, brake and switch on hazard warning lights

comment: Caution of congestion: With this traffic sign you should reduce the speed of your car and increase the distance to the vehicle in front. Get a better picture of the situation by watching the traffic in front of the next vehicle and, if necessary, drive a bit offset in the lane. Turn on your hazard lights when driving towards the end of a traffic jam.

question_text: What must you do when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: Reduce speed before the bend
Drive as far as possible over on the right-hand side
Indicate left before the bend

correct_answers.text: Drive as far as possible over on the right-hand side

comment: The traffic sign announces a dangerous left turn. Decrease your speed to keep the centrifugal force small. Oncoming traffic could reach your lane due to its centrifugal force. Also, a vehicle could have broken down behind the curve. Drive as far as possible to the right. You follow the road, there's no turn. Therefore, you do not have to indicate.

question_text: What do you do within this danger section?

options.text: Drive more slowly, watch out for wild animals
Dip the headlights and brake when you see wild animals
Do not avoid hitting wild animals if oncoming traffic would be endangered

correct_answers.text: Drive more slowly, watch out for wild animals
Dip the headlights and brake when you see wild animals
Do not avoid hitting wild animals if oncoming traffic would be endangered

comment: Attention wild animals crossing: This sign is set up on routes, where a lot of wild animal accidents happened already. As soon as you see this sign, you should reduce the speed and be ready to brake. Pay particular attention to the roadside. If you see an animal, you should brake and dim. If game suddenly jumps in front of you, you should make an emergency brake. Avoid dodging, because then you might get into the oncoming lane.

question_text: What must you be prepared for upon seeing this traffic sign?

options.text: For side winds
For counter-steering
For aircraft overhead

comment: This traffic sign indicates a section of the route with crosswinds. This is especially true for bridges and overpasses. If there's strong wind from the side you have to reduce your speed. You need to be prepared to hold on and countersteer to stay in the lane. The traffic sign has nothing to do with air traffic.

question_text: What must you be prepared for upon seeing this traffic sign?

options.text: For an alteration in the responsiveness of the vehicle
For the necessity for counter-steering
For the necessity for adjusting speed

correct_answers.text: For an alteration in the responsiveness of the vehicle
For the necessity for adjusting speed

comment: If you encounter this traffic sign, you have to adjust to strong crosswinds. Most commonly, this traffic sign appears on road sections that are particularly exposed to the wind - for example, on bridges or overpasses. With strong crosswinds, the driver must countersteer in order to stay in the lane. You also need to adjust the speed of your car to the wind conditions.

question_text: What should you anticipate when you see this road sign?

options.text: Vehicles ahead that may swerve out suddenly to the left
Vehicles ahead that may brake suddenly
Tree branches lying on the roadway

correct_answers.text: Vehicles ahead that may swerve out suddenly to the left
Vehicles ahead that may brake suddenly
Tree branches lying on the roadway

comment: Because of trees, tall vehicles can brake suddenly and swerve. Tall vehicles can tear off branches as they pass, and these then lie on the roadway. Be especially attentive.

question_text: What must you anticipate with this road sign?

options.text: Trees could protrude into my road area
There could be branches lying on the roadway
Vehicles could swerve suddenly

correct_answers.text: Trees could protrude into my road area
There could be branches lying on the roadway

comment: All 3 answers are correct. Trees may lie in the driveway, branches may lie in the road, and cars may suddenly give way.
